title: TruePPM seed data v2
description: Canonical JSON seed format, v2 (ADR-0114). Additive superset of v1: dates may be authored as offsets from a top-level `anchor` resolved at import day, and an ordered `events` timeline is replayed chronologically with backdated history so the demo tells a life, not a snapshot. v1 documents remain valid under the v1 validator; v2 adds `anchor`, the relative-date grammar, and `events`.

schema_version.description: Schema major.minor. validate_seed() rejects unsupported majors. 2.1 is an additive minor (#3603): program backlog_items / ceremonies / agent_actions, project share_links, task acceptance_criteria, and the task.note / task.react / task.ack / time.log events. A 2.0 document is valid unchanged.

anchor.description: Optional explicit reference date for relative offsets ("A"). When omitted, the anchor resolves to the import day, so the demo always looks current. Authoring an explicit anchor pins a fixed-date demo (discouraged).

accounts.description: User logins referenced by the seed. Created only when import runs with --create-users; on the sample path they resolve to namespaced unusable-password persona rows.

risks.description: Program-scoped risks. Project-scoped risks live under each project.

events.description: Ordered timeline (ADR-0114). Each event mutates a target through a real write path and writes a history row dated to `at`. Events are applied in `at` order (ties broken by array index). The synthesizer fills unauthored status moves; authored events always win.

slug.description: File-local stable identifier, kebab-case. Capped at 40 so the program slug fits Program.code.

wbsPath.description: ltree path, e.g. "1.2.3". Per-project task identity.

taskRef.description: A task by wbs path. Bare for the enclosing project, or "<project-slug>:<wbs-path>" for a sibling project.

seedDate.description: Either an ISO date ("2026-01-05") or an anchor-relative offset ("A-120", "A+15"). The offset is capped at 4 digits (~27 years) so a crafted seed can't drive an unbounded replay span. A trailing "!" opts out of weekend-snapping so the date lands exactly. Relative dates that fall on a non-working day snap forward to the next working day via the project calendar.

seedTimestamp.description: An event time: ISO datetime ("2026-01-05T14:10"), or anchor-relative "A-87T14:10" / "A-87" (midnight). The offset is capped at 4 digits (~27 years). Timestamps are never weekend-snapped — an event occurs when it occurs.

slug.description: Program natural key. Persisted into Program.code; re-import upserts on (workspace, code).

lead.description: Account slug of the program lead.

backlog_items.description: v2.1. Program backlog (BacklogItem, ADR-0069) — the intake pool work is proposed into before any project commits to it.

ceremonies.description: v2.1. Recurring program ceremonies (CeremonyTemplate, ADR-0079). Sprint events — standup, sprint review, retrospective — are team-level and rejected here, exactly as the API rejects them.

agent_actions.description: v2.1, BUNDLED SAMPLES ONLY. An audited agent trail for the agent-oversight panel. Audit evidence must not be authorable by a file a user controls, so every non-sample import rejects this key. Rows are written through the real hash chain and marked as sample data in hashed fields.

mc_history_enabled.description: Program-level override of the Monte Carlo run-history feature (ADR-0144). Omit to inherit the workspace default; set true on a program whose projects author `forecast_history` so the MC history panel/tornado are populated on load (#3494).

mc_history_attribution_audience.description: Program-level override of who may see the run-author name on Monte Carlo history (ADR-0144). Omit to inherit the workspace default.

pulled_to.description: The task this item became, as "<project-slug>:<wbs-path>". Only valid with status pulled.

cadence_day.description: weekly/biweekly: a weekday ("tuesday"); monthly: ordinal-weekday ("1st-thursday"); omit for on_milestone.

agentAction.description: One audited agent decision (AgentAction, ADR-0112). Sample-only — see program.agent_actions.

principal.description: Account on whose behalf the agent acted.

shareLink.description: v2.1, BUNDLED SAMPLES ONLY. A public read-only link (ShareLink, ADR-0245). The token is always minted at load and never read from the file; every non-sample import rejects this key.

recurrence.description: v2.1. Makes this task a recurrence template (TaskRecurrenceRule, ADR-0090). Only the rule is seeded; occurrences spawn lazily on the generator's horizon, and the template leaves the CPM graph. end_date or end_count bounds the series; neither means it never ends.

team.description: v2.1. The project's default team (ADR-0078): its name and the Scrum Master / Product Owner facets. Membership itself mirrors the project's members; list here only the people whose facets or presence you want to state.

role.description: Program membership role granted on import.
Project membership role granted on import.

boardLane.description: A named lane WITHIN a board column (#2967). Keys are unique project-wide.

boardColumn.description: One Kanban column. Mirrors BoardColumnConfig.columns; the seed cannot express a shape the board API would reject.

taskAttachment.description: An external reference on a task. URL-only: TaskAttachment stores a file XOR an external_url, and a seed is a text document, so the file half is deliberately not expressible.

taskBlocker.description: The explicit human blocker flag (#1135, ADR-0124). A present cluster means blocked. `reason` is optional: an export withholds the private reason text from anyone but the task's assignee or an @-mentioned user (#4082), and the importer stamps a placeholder so the task still imports as blocked. NOT the derived has-incomplete-predecessors signal, and `blocking_task` is a soft 'waiting on' link that never enters CPM.

exceptions.description: Non-working date ranges (holidays, shutdowns, PTO). Materialized as CalendarException rows and also treated as non-working days by the relative-date resolver (a date snapped forward will skip these).

forecastHistory.description: Backfill parameters for ProjectForecastSnapshot history (#376, ADR-0211). Synthesizes one snapshot per day across `days`, drifting the CPM finish and each Monte Carlo percentile from its `*_start` to its `*_end` date while `commitment_finish` stays fixed — so the forecast-trend chart shows a real slip and total-float pressure turning negative. Deterministic (seeded on program + project). MC percentiles are all-or-none: provide the full p50/p80/p95 start+end set, or omit them for a CPM-only history (MC lines stay null until someone runs Monte Carlo).

commitment_finish.description: The promised finish date that does NOT move over the window; total_float_days is derived as (commitment_finish - cpm_finish) each day.

completion_ratio.description: Fraction of tasks complete by the newest snapshot; completed_task_count ramps 0 -> round(completion_ratio * task_count) across the window. Default 0.5.

account.description: Optional account slug linking this resource to a user login (Resource.user).

skills.description: v2.1. Skills on the workspace catalog (Skill, de-duplicated case-insensitively) with this resource's proficiency.

estimate.description: Three-point PERT estimate in working days. All-or-none: present means all three; omit entirely for unestimated tasks. Never set on summary or milestone tasks.

type.description: TaskType. tech_debt (2.1) is schedulable work that counts toward velocity like a story.

is_subtask.description: v2.1. A drawer subtask (ADR-0060): its wbs_path is one level under a leaf task that has no structural children, and it cannot itself have children.

skill_requirements.description: v2.1. Skills this task needs (TaskSkillRequirement), matched against resources[].skills by name, case-insensitively.

status.description: Final state at import. The events timeline + synthesizer reconstruct how the task reached it.

parent_epic.description: wbs_path of the epic task grouping this story (Task.parent_epic).

labels.description: Slugs of project labels (ADR-0400) attached to this task, referencing project.labels.

links.description: Informational task-to-task relations (ADR-0455) authored on this task as the source, e.g. "relates to" / "blocks" / "duplicates". A relation is a non-scheduling cross-reference — distinct from a CPM `dependency` — so it carries no lag, dep_type, or schedule effect.

board_lane.description: Named lane WITHIN this task's status column (#2967); must match a lane key on the project's board_columns entry for that status.

acceptance_criteria.description: v2.1. Tickable acceptance criteria (AcceptanceCriterion, ADR-0105), in display order. A task.ac_met beat carrying `criterion` ticks one by index on a dated beat.

assignments.description: Resource allocations on this task. assignee is the responsible user; assignments are capacity (Resource + units fraction of max_units).

lag.description: Calendar days. Positive = delay, negative = lead.

taskRelation.description: An informational task-to-task cross-reference (ADR-0455), authored on a task's `links` array with that task as the source. `target` is a task ref (bare wbs path for the enclosing project, or "<project-slug>:<wbs-path>" for a sibling project in the same program). Distinct from a scheduling `dependency`: inert, no CPM edge, no lag.

link_type.description: RELATES_TO is symmetric; BLOCKS and DUPLICATES are directional (source → target).

target_milestone.description: wbs_path of a milestone task in the same project.

captured_at.description: When the baseline was captured (drives backdated Baseline history). Defaults to the project start.

tasks.description: Task refs this risk is linked to. Bare wbs path = enclosing project; "<slug>:<wbs>" = sibling project (program-scoped risks only).

event.description: One timeline beat. `target` identifies what is mutated ("task:<taskRef>", "sprint:<sprintRef>", "risk:<slug>"). `actor` is an account slug; the row's history_user is attributed to it.

action.description: Replayed actions. retro.action creates a RetroActionItem on the target sprint's retro, lazily creating the parent SprintRetro on first use; an optional `notes` on any retro.action beat sets/updates that SprintRetro's meeting-summary notes (typically authored once, on the retro's last action-item beat). retro.promote promotes an existing action item (matched by `body`) into a project-backlog task (ADR-0114 §7 / #1109). task.block/task.unblock raise and clear the explicit blocker flag, so a blocked span has a real duration on the timeline rather than a field that reads "blocked 0 days". risk.note appends a RiskComment, giving a risk.status flip its reason. v2.1 (#3603): task.note appends a dated TaskNote (`decision`/`pinned` optional); task.react / task.ack add a reaction or an acknowledgement to a comment declared with a `slug`; time.log writes a TimeEntry dated to the beat and is never forward-dated.

target.description: What the event mutates: "task:<project-slug>:<wbs-path>" (task.*, scope_inject/resolve, time.log), "sprint:<project-slug>:<sprint-slug>" (sprint.activate/close, retro.action/promote), "project:<project-slug>" (baseline.capture), "risk:<slug>" (risk.status, risk.note), or "comment:<slug>" (task.react, task.ack).

slug.description: On task.comment: a document-unique comment id that reply_to, task.react and task.ack can refer to.

reply_to.description: On task.comment: the slug of the top-level comment this one replies to. Replies are one level deep.

criterion.description: On task.ac_met: zero-based index into the target task's acceptance_criteria to tick. Omit to mark the story ready instead.

emoji.description: On task.react. Mirrors the API's reaction allow-list.

decision.description: On task.note: mark the note as a decision so it appears in the Decisions view.

goal_impact.description: On sprint.scope_inject: whether the injection threatens the sprint goal.

notes.description: On retro.action: sets the target sprint's SprintRetro.notes (the meeting-summary text) rather than the RetroActionItem itself. Optional and typically authored once per retro.

is_active.description: On baseline.capture: whether this capture supersedes the project's current active baseline (deactivating it), collapsing the real app's separate capture + activate steps into one beat. Defaults to false — a captured baseline stays superseded unless authored active.

blocker_type.description: On task.block: the structured triage classification.

blocking_task.description: On task.block: a soft "waiting on" task ref. Never enters CPM.

label.description: A project-scoped, colored task label (ADR-0400). Referenced by task.labels via slug.

color.description: Stable categorical palette key (LabelColor), never a raw hex.

lead.description: Account slug of this project's lead. Distinct from the program lead and from the OWNER membership: a workstream lead is who a program manager asks about this project, and is what the project header and program roll-up display.

health.description: PM override for the project health chip (#520). Omit or AUTO to defer to the rollup; the explicit values are a manual judgment that surfaces immediately in lists and on the program overview.

members.description: Per-project memberships. Omit to grant every account its program-level accounts[].role on this project; declare it to give one person different roles on different projects.

agile_features.description: Accepted and ignored. The model field was removed in migration 0123 and the value is now derived from the project's own sprints; a document carrying this key still imports so an existing hand-authored seed does not break on upgrade.

share_links.description: v2.1, BUNDLED SAMPLES ONLY. Public read-only links on this project; see $defs/shareLink.

board_columns.description: Kanban board configuration (BoardColumnConfig). All five canonical statuses must appear exactly once. Omit to leave the project on the API's hardcoded defaults.

labels.description: Project label catalog (ADR-0400). Tasks reference these by slug via task.labels.
